args.prompt: Using the reference character design exactly (same cat-unicorn: white round head with pointy cat ears with pink inner ears, golden spiral horn, closed happy eyes, pink blush stripes, tiny nose and cat smile, small white bean body, thin stick arms and legs, pink mane and fluffy pink tail), draw a BOUNCY GALLOP sprite strip: 8 frames in one horizontal row, side view facing right, equal spacing, same ground line. Joyful bouncing run, head and body bobbing up and down, legs swinging wide front and back, a clear moment in the cycle where both feet leave the ground, ears flapping, arms swinging, mane and tail flowing back. IMPORTANT SCALE: this is a LOW RESOLUTION retro sprite, each character is only about 48 pixels tall on a tiny 400x80 pixel canvas, VERY LARGE CHUNKY pixels like a Super Nintendo sprite, no fine detail. 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat colors, no anti-aliasing, no gradients. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else, no text.
